policy: Budget = the measured develop-tip build + ~5% headroom (10,400 KiB vs 9,909.1 KiB measured). The metric is every .js file under .next/static/chunks/ — the full client payload (initial + lazy) of the PWA. The budget may only move through a NEW measurement recorded here (validateBudgetConfig rejects a ceiling more than 20% above the recorded measurement, so a failing check cannot be silenced by cranking the number). The check is non-required by design: it makes regressions visible in the PR check list, it does not gate merges. Practice adopted from Excalidraw's size-limit workflow (majors-research wave 3).
